title: A part with zero or negative on-hand quantity is never shown
permissions_required: A role with the existing inventory-reports permission (Story 1 prerequisite).
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A part with exactly zero on-hand quantity exists at the selected location, and (if producible) one with a negative on-hand quantity.
steps: 1. Open the Inventory Value report scoped to that location.
2. Search for the zero-quantity part by its part number.
3. Search for the negative-quantity part if one exists.
expected: 1. The zero-quantity part is not listed.
2. The negative-quantity part is not listed either — only quantities greater than zero are valued.
design_ref: none — design not yet available (spec-only authoring)
